accepted_scope.scope_exception: The owner accepts this smaller sampled first experiment in place of the retained planning targets.

amendment.consequence_recorded: Any downstream artifact, write-up or publication derived from this corpus must not be represented as permission-cleared. The protocol's own reading of the platform terms (v11 section 3) remains part of the record.
amendment.direction: Owner declined to record a source-use basis statement and directed that the source-use readiness precondition be removed from the retained protocol.
not_asserted: source_use_basis (no cited permission, license, platform/access term or creator authorization is claimed)
SOURCE_READY = true (the field means permission is supported; it is not)
retained_constraints: No public redistribution of raw playlist memberships or audio.
Confirmation membership-recovery results remain uncomputed and uninspected.
The existing source_use_blocker_v1.json remains the historical record that no basis was asserted.
amendment.supersedes_scope: Gate A source-use precondition only. Membership, sample, curator/duplicate-grouping, version-purge, feature-input, scorer, grid, mask and confirmation policies remain frozen.

confirmation_access.policy: Do not compute, open, summarize or use confirmation membership-recovery results during development or weight selection. Run the five reserved groups once only after a ranking candidate is frozen under the retained protocol.

contract_change_policy: Any change to source roles, memberships, samples, curator/duplicate groups, version purges, feature inputs, scorer, grid, masks or confirmation policy requires a new versioned contract and new hashes before execution.

execution_authorization.authorization_basis: Owner direction 2026-09-15: proceed without a source-use basis statement; the source-use readiness precondition is removed from the retained protocol. No permission basis is asserted by this amendment.

fixed_data_policy.version_policy: Retain the conservative recording/version relationships and all existing boundary purges; do not relax or adjudicate them during the search.

fixed_ranking_protocol.candidate_selection: Use development evidence only, with the retained nested curator/duplicate-group split and recording/version purges.
fixed_ranking_protocol.comparison_population: Use the same eligible feature-complete population for every applicable arm and preserve approved missing-profile behavior.
fixed_ranking_protocol.search_space: Reuse the existing pinned h/rho/w_c/eta grid, scorer, top-three aggregator, masks, tie breaking, uncertainty procedure and ablations without modification.

prohibited_scope: confirmation performance computation or inspection before candidate freeze
mapper, prompt, scorer or historical-artifact changes
output, admission, probability, suitability or strictness calibration
